Himalaya Digyton Pet Digestion Oral Drops Sugar Free is an Ayurvedic proprietary veterinary formulation specially developed to support digestive health in pets. It functions as a digestive stimulant, antiflatulent, and bowel regulator to help manage indigestion, dyspepsia, colic, flatulence, and gastrointestinal upsets in weaned puppies.   * Functions as a digestive stimulant to aid in the digestion and assimilation of food

  * Provides antiflatulent action to help relieve colic, flatulence, and gastrointestinal discomfort

  * Acts as a bowel regulator to regularise bowel movement and function

  * Helps improve appetite and digestive comfort in pets experiencing indigestion or dyspepsia

  * Supports gastrointestinal tolerance during sudden changes in food

DOSAGE
Puppies: Small breeds - 5-8 drops twice daily; Large breeds - 10-15 drops twice daily
  * Ayurvedic Proprietary Veterinary Medicine.

  * Not For Human Use. For Animal Use Only.

  * Keep out of the reach of children.

  * Shake well before use. Store in a dry place, away from direct heat and sunlight. Do not refrigerate.

Frequently Asked Questions:
Q. What is Himalaya Digyton Pet Oral Drops used for?
A. Himalaya Digyton is used as a digestive stimulant, antiflatulent, and bowel regulator to help manage indigestion, flatulence, colic, and gastrointestinal upsets, as well as to improve appetite and bowel function in pets.
Q. How should Himalaya Digyton Pet Oral Drops be stored?
A. Shake well before use. Store in a dry place away from direct heat and sunlight. Do not refrigerate, and keep out of the reach of children.
